2026 House Results

Add NBC News to Google

Republicans are seeking to protect a narrow majority in the House, while Democrats must notch a net gain of 3 seats to flip the chamber. The GOP shored things up before the election with friendly redistricting in a number of states. But Democrats hope the intensity of voter response to President Donald Trump’s second term sweeps over the levees Republicans drew in redistricting.
